BTC.note: Sold 2 Nov 2026 – no longer held; exchange hacks (Binance, Mercado Bitcoin) and BTCPay drains, Bitcoin itself unaffected
BTC.detail: Bob sold his Bitcoin fund on 2 Nov 2026; kept only as market context. Binance says its US$6.3bn hack began with a North Korea-linked fake job interview (not a flaw in Bitcoin); about 98% replenished, US$2.85bn frozen. Mercado Bitcoin is covering ~US$38m losses. BTCPay Server 2.4.1 and older had hot wallets drained. Quantum: still theoretical. Checked 4 Nov 2026.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Bob sold all his MSTR on 2 Nov 2026. Strategy itself was not hacked; its custodians were not affected by the Binance hack.

SEMI.detail: No serious breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Nvidia's minor Brev developer-cloud incident (4-20 Oct) was contained with no misuse found. Taiwan is moving to criminalise AI-chip smuggling to China; this is enforcement, not a threat to the fund. Checked 3 Nov 2026.

SPCX.detail: No confirmed SpaceX or Starlink breach reported. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
